name: library-webapp

dependencies.name: library-api
dependencies.description: Browse/search the catalog, borrow and return books, and view overdue loans.

dependencies.name: suggestion-agent
dependencies.description: Send the member's mood description and show the returned suggestions.

dependencies.name: loan-agent
dependencies.description: Send the member's plain-language loan question and show the returned answer.

description: The single-page app both Members and Librarians sign into: catalog browsing and search, borrowing and returning books, mood-based suggestion chat, loan Q&A chat, and the librarian's catalog management and overdue views. Holds no business data of its own — everything is read from and written to library-api and the two agents.
